notes.title: My Demonic Romance 0.19.4 - Unexpected alliance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869514/674cad4fce5f5ef219bfe7108f07afceddf7e0b8.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Check out the latest update for MDR, featuring 1 new story scene, 2 animated CGs, 1 static CG (to be animated later) and 215 lines of unique spoken dialogue.

May was a very short month for us, so this is a slightly smaller update than usual, but you can be sure that what you're getting is exciting enough to make up for that. For example, we're trying something new in terms of the options for the scene with Angela and Riley, giving our hero enough stamina to please them both. We know many players have asked for this, and if the feedback we receive is positive, we're planning to introduce the same feature for all "polyamorous" scenes, past, present and future alike.

Features:
[list]
[*] 2 animated artworks
[list]
[*] Angela enjoying her party of three with Riley and our hero
[*] Riley enjoying her party of three with Angela and our hero
[/list]
[*] 1 static artwork
[list]
[*] Angela and Riley enjoying our hero's last efforts (to be animated in the next update)
[/list]
[*] 1 story scene
[list]
[*] Party of three with Angela, Riley and our hero
[/list]
[*] 215 voiced lines
[/list]
Have fun ;)

[b]Andrealphus[/b]

notes.title: My Demonic Romance 0.19.3 - Riley rules
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869514/6cfd1191a0a54006d18e0dcdc692c5833e7d6547.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Here is our latest MDR update with 1 new story scene, 26 modified scenes, 4 animated CGs, 1015 voiced lines. And this time, it's Riley who comes to Lily and our hero with an offering of peace!
As we did in release 0.18.1, we continue to enrich the story once Lily's behavior is set at the end of Chapter 1. Thus most of the events in Chapter 3 have been reworked with the same purpose: to put more light on the "Lily" of your choice (making her dominant, submissive, or equal).
Additionally, early in the game's development, there was an issue with the volume of many voice lines, and we're currently remastering them to improve the overall quality. This all takes time, but we hope you'll appreciate the effort.

Features:
[list]

[/list]

Have fun ;)

notes.title: My Demonic Romance 0.18.1 - About Lily
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869514/816d075c23ec82cde1f951c7314ae34ca5df5894.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Here is our new update for MDR. It is a bit special since it focuses on the story already available. We've read many comments about Lily's behavior and the lack of impact Chapter 1's choices have on Lily (making her dominant, submissive, or equal) in the rest of the story. The desire for consistency is understandable, and we worked to enrich the story once Lily's behavior is set at the end of Chapter 1. As a result, most of the events in Chapter 2 have been reworked to put more light on the "Lily" of your choice. During Chapter 3, we also have a better build-up for the attraction Lily could have for Claire or Hector according to your choices. These represent a lot (nearly 2640 new lines) of new texts and dialogues. Therefore, the new dialogues are not voiced yet, but they will be. All this new content will appear without new choices if you play a run as before, which means there are no updates on the Walkthrough this month.

Thank you for your support.

Features:
[list]
[*] 15 modified scenes in Chapter 2
[list]
[*] + 1 800 news lines (for the most part adding Queen and Slave behavior)
[/list]
[*] 15 new mini-scenes with Lily (5 Queen, 5 Slave, 5 Girlfriend)
[list]
[*] +490 new lines
[/list]
[*] 5 new mini-scenes with Lily and Claire
[list]
[*] +175 lines
[/list]
[*] 5 new mini-scenes with Lily and Hector
[list]
[*] +175 lines
[/list]
Have fun ;)

[b]Andrealphus[/b]
